name: ironwallengraving-dr-site
description: Disaster-recovery private site and asset bucket. This is a separate S3 bucket owned by the DR stack and used by the DR CloudFront distribution. It receives replicated site/assets objects from the production site bucket when production-to-DR S3 replication is enabled.

rules.description: Keeps current site objects but expires old noncurrent versions under site/ after 30 days.
Expires old storefront renderer build objects and old noncurrent versions after 30 days.
Backstop cleanup for tagged catalog snapshot objects under site/catalog/ after 30 days.

versioning.description: Versioning is enabled so the bucket can receive replicated objects from the production site bucket.

bucket_policy.description: Allows the DR CloudFront distribution to read private DR site bucket objects.

replication.description: One-way replication from the production site bucket to the DR site bucket. Existing objects still need an initial backfill or batch replication step.
